# Security & Exposure Checklist: Pipeline and solution skeleton

**Purpose**: Check the quality of the requirements for loopback binding, container hardening, workflow permissions and injection, and the release tag guard, before tasks are generated
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the binding requirement say which loopback addresses count as compliant (IPv4 `127.0.0.1`, IPv6 `::1`, or both) and what happens when IPv6 loopback is absent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Research R5]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all the configuration sources that could widen the listener listed? The list should include env vars, command-line `--urls`, `Kestrel:Endpoints` config, an `appsettings.json` next to the binary, and `ASPNETCORE_PREFERHOSTINGURLS`. [Completeness, Research R5]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the hostile-environment smoke set include the HTTPS-port and `DOTNET_`-prefixed variants (`ASPNETCORE_HTTPS_PORTS`, `DOTNET_URLS`), or does it state why they're excluded? [Gap, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK004 Are container hardening requirements (non-root user, read-only root filesystem, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges) stated as requirements of the image itself, or only as flags the smoke test passes? [Completeness, Research R7/R8]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it decided whether user-facing run instructions (README) should recommend the same hardening flags the smoke test uses? [Gap, Plan §Documentation changes]
- [ ] CHK006 Are workflow token permissions specified per job for both workflows, including what the verify jobs that run PR code may do? [Completeness, Research R13]
- [ ] CHK007 Is there a requirement that no secret or token value appears in workflow logs or in command-line arguments? [Completeness, Constitution III, Research R10/R13]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "listen on loopback only" stated in a way that can be measured, i.e. "every listening socket of the process is on a loopback address, and at least one exists"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "not reachable from another container" defined precisely, i.e. connection refused rather than a timeout, with a positive control? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the tag validation regex stated exactly, along with the rule that it's applied before the tag value is used anywhere else? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Research R9]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "untrusted input must not reach a shell" defined as a concrete rule, i.e. no `${{ }}` carrying a ref, tag or PR value inside `run:`? [Clarity, Research R13]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Does the spec Assumption ("container smoke test checks health from inside the container") match the plan's approach of a helper container sharing the network namespace, plus an outside-in probe? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the loopback requirement consistent across the executable, the container, `dotnet run`, and the health contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, contracts/health-endpoint.md]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the pinning rules (actions by SHA, images by digest) consistent with the Dependabot scope that keeps them current? [Consistency, Research R13]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Do the requirements cover a tag name crafted to inject shell commands (e.g. `v0.0.$(id)-alpha`)? [Coverage, Research R9]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the requirements cover the tag being moved or re-pointed while a release run is in progress (tag commit ≠ commit being built)? [Edge Case, Research R9]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the requirements cover a PR from a fork running `release.yml` verify jobs, i.e. what token and permissions it gets? [Coverage, Gap, Research R12]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the container's listening behavior specified when the base image's `ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=8080` is present? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]

## Non-Functional / Threat Model

- [ ] CHK019 Is it stated that the tag guard prevents mistakes but is not an access control (write access is the trust boundary), and is that accepted explicitly rather than implied? [Assumption, Research R9, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK020 Is it accepted explicitly that, without branch protection, the PR gate is advisory, and is the compensating control (maintainer merges only on green, RELEASING.md) documented? [Assumption, Research R13]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a requirement for build provenance or signatures intentionally left out, with the reason recorded (`SHA256SUMS` proves integrity, not origin)? [Gap, Research R11]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
